tools.name: ssh_start_web
tools.description: Start or reuse the desktop background service. Return its actual local web URL; desktop manages the port automatically.

tools.name: ssh_list_profiles
tools.description: List saved SSH connection profiles and whether a password is saved. Never returns passwords. Use the requested target profile_id with ssh_connect. If none exist, call ssh_start_web and ask the user to add one in 连接配置.

tools.name: ssh_connect
tools.description: Connect or reconnect a disconnected SSH session using a saved profile and local credentials file. Also starts the web UI and broker if stopped. Idempotently reuses an existing matching session; never replaces another target or takes control from the user. On owner=human, wait for the user. After reconnecting, check remote state; never automatically replay interrupted commands. No password argument is accepted; use the web UI for credentials.

tools.name: ssh_list_sessions
tools.description: List all independent host sessions, targets, ownership and active command IDs. Does not connect or change control.

tools.name: ssh_status
tools.description: Inspect the explicitly selected SSH session. When disconnected, use ssh_list_profiles then ssh_connect. If owner is human, wait for the user to return control; do not bypass the shared terminal with another connection.

session_id.description: Exact session_id returned by ssh_connect or ssh_list_sessions

tools.name: ssh_execute
tools.description: Execute a Bash command in the persistent PTY. cwd/env persist; output merges stdout/stderr. Commands run serially. If running, use ssh_poll; never replay an uncertain command. Do not change terminal settings, shell options, traps, prompts, or __agent_* variables. Use a subshell for exit, exec, set -e, or interactive programs. Output is bounded to the latest 2M characters.

session_id.description: Exact session_id returned by ssh_connect or ssh_list_sessions

tools.name: ssh_poll
tools.description: Read a command result. Supply previous offset for incremental output. Waiting does not cancel.

session_id.description: Exact session_id returned by ssh_connect or ssh_list_sessions

tools.name: ssh_cancel
tools.description: Send Ctrl-C to the active foreground command. Disconnect if shell recovery fails.

session_id.description: Exact session_id returned by ssh_connect or ssh_list_sessions

tools.name: ssh_disconnect
tools.description: Explicitly close an agent-owned SSH session when requested. Use ssh_connect with a saved profile to connect again. Never disconnect a human-owned session.

session_id.description: Exact session_id returned by ssh_connect or ssh_list_sessions
